The middle segment is determined by which difference is larger between the row and column coordinate differences. The diagonal length appears to depend on the absolute value of the row and column coordinate differences. The light ray analogy is fitting!

I've calculated the differences in row and column positions and am figuring out the relevant signs and magnitudes. The straight segment looks vertical this time.
